name: dashboard
description: Scripting OpenWrt 与 Clash/Mihomo 管理面板：实时流量、系统状态、节点切换测速、规则与连接管理；支持 Nikki 配置文件编辑选用、订阅及附加规则管理。功能取决于插件版本与设备权限。

localizedDescriptions.zh: Scripting OpenWrt 与 Clash/Mihomo 管理面板：实时流量、系统状态、节点切换测速、规则与连接管理；支持 Nikki 配置文件编辑选用、订阅及附加规则管理。功能取决于插件版本与设备权限。
localizedDescriptions.en: Scripting dashboard for OpenWrt and Clash/Mihomo: live traffic, system status, proxy testing, rules and connections, plus Nikki profiles, subscriptions and extra rules. Features depend on plugin versions and device permissions.
